faqs.question: What is the objective of this scheme?
faqs.answer: The objective of the scheme is the economic upliftment of Scheduled Caste (SC), Scheduled Tribe (ST), Small and Marginal Farmers (SMF), and Below Poverty Line (BPL) families. It also aims to provide protein-rich food through eggs to these categories and to ensure a regular supply of healthy eggs to nearby schools under the Scheme of Mid-Day Meals.

faqs.question: Who are eligible to benefit under this scheme?
faqs.answer: The scheme is meant for SC/ST, SMF, and BPL families of Daman & Diu. The financial assistance is provided to the individual beneficiary belonging to these eligible categories.

faqs.question: What type of financial assistance is provided under the scheme?
faqs.answer: Financial assistance is provided in the form of a subsidy covering the construction of a poultry shed, purchase of reared pullets of 18–21 weeks age, poultry equipments and the purchase cost of feed for four months until the beneficiary starts earning from the sale of eggs. Each beneficiary is entitled to 50% subsidy of the total unit cost, limited to ₹30,000/- per unit.

faqs.question: For how long can a beneficiary avail the benefit under the scheme?
faqs.answer: A beneficiary will be entitled to get the benefit of the scheme for a period of two years or till he becomes self-sufficient. The unit must be operated for at least the minimum period of two years as required under the scheme conditions.

faqs.question: How is the subsidy disbursed to the beneficiary?
faqs.answer: The subsidy may be paid directly to the individual beneficiary or to the suppliers, body supplying goods, approved agency, or institution. The Veterinary Officer, Daman & Diu, disburses the subsidy after completion of the poultry unit, including the construction of the shed and purchase of pullets, feed, and equipment.

faqs.question: Is there any training requirement under the scheme?
faqs.answer: Yes. The participant must have a background in poultry farming, and in cases where such a background is not available, the participant must undergo practical training. Training will be provided by the Department of Animal Husbandry & Veterinary Services, if required.

faqs.question: Are there operational conditions attached to the scheme?
faqs.answer: Yes. The poultry unit must be operated on scientific lines as per the technical guidance and services provided by the Department of Animal Husbandry & Veterinary Services, Daman & Diu. The participant must maintain prescribed records, furnish required information to the Veterinary Officer from time to time, and follow instructions issued by the Department.

faqs.question: Is the beneficiary required to supply eggs to schools?
faqs.answer: Yes. The beneficiary has to compulsorily sell or supply the surplus eggs to nearby schools under the Scheme of Mid-Day Meals. The Extension Officer (Dairy) or Veterinary Officer (DP) will make a fortnightly payment to the beneficiary for the regular supply of eggs.

faqs.question: What happens if the beneficiary violates the scheme conditions?
faqs.answer: If there is a breach of any of the terms and conditions, the entire amount of financial assistance is recoverable from the beneficiary as per law, subject to Dadra & Nagar Haveli Jurisdiction. The participant is also required to execute a bond accepting all terms and conditions of the scheme.

faqs.question: What certifications are required before subsidy is released?
faqs.answer: After completion of the small-scale poultry unit, a completion certificate must be obtained from the Field Level Worker, namely Veterinary Stockman or Extension Officer (Dairy), and the certificate must be countersigned by the concerned Veterinary Officer (D.P) or Veterinary Officer (Animal Husbandry) before disbursement of subsidy.

faqs.question: What is the objective of the Establishment of 12 Milch Animal Farm" scheme?
faqs.answer: The "Establishment 12 Milch Animal Farm" scheme aims to promote animal husbandry as an independent business, encourage livestock owners to adopt dairy farming, and enhance rural employment opportunities.

faqs.question: Who is eligible to apply for this scheme?
faqs.answer: Any livestock owner planning to establish a dairy farm with up to 12 milch animals is eligible to apply for the scheme.

faqs.question: What type of financial assistance is provided under this scheme?
faqs.answer: The scheme provides interest subsidies, assistance for shed construction, subsidies for animal insurance premiums, and financial support for purchasing essential dairy equipment.

faqs.question: How much interest subsidy is available under this scheme?
faqs.answer: Beneficiaries in the general category receive a 7.5% interest subsidy for up to 5 years, while SC/ST/Female beneficiaries receive an 8.5% subsidy. For Gir/Kankrej breed units, the maximum interest subsidy is 12%.

faqs.question: What is the maximum financial assistance for shed construction?
faqs.answer: General category beneficiaries can receive up to ₹1,50,000/- (50% of actual expenditure), while Gir/Kankrej breed beneficiaries can receive up to ₹2,25,000/- (75% of actual expenditure).

faqs.question: Does the scheme provide financial assistance for animal insurance?
faqs.answer: Yes, the scheme covers 75% of the insurance premium (up to ₹43,200/-) for the general category and 90% of the premium (up to ₹51,840/-) for Gir/Kankrej breed units for a period of three years.

faqs.question: How can an applicant apply for this scheme?
faqs.answer: The applicant must first obtain loan approval from a Reserve Bank-recognized bank. After that, they can apply online through the I-Khedut (https://ikhedut.gujarat.gov.in/) portal, attach the required documents, and submit the application.

faqs.question: What types of dairy animals can be purchased under this scheme?
faqs.answer: The scheme supports the purchase of cows and buffaloes for dairy farming.

faqs.question: Does the scheme provide any assistance for farm renovation?
faqs.answer: No, the scheme does not provide assistance for renovation or repair of existing dairy farms.

faqs.question: Is it mandatory to take a loan to receive benefits under this scheme?
faqs.answer: Yes, obtaining a loan from a recognized financial institution is mandatory for purchasing livestock and availing of scheme benefits.

name: Establishment of Vermicompost Units
description: The scheme “Establishment of Vermicompost Units” is implemented by the Department of Horticulture, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to promote sustainable agriculture and organic farming by providing financial assistance for setting up vermicompost units to farmers and women self-help groups.
benefits: Under this scheme, a subsidy of 75% of the cost, up to ₹33,300/- per unit, is provided for setting up vermicompost units (including pit construction and provision of earthworms).
eligibility: The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand.. The applicant must be a farmer and must hold a valid Udhyan Card.. The applicant must have either their own land or land on lease.. All women members of self-help groups are also eligible to avail benefits under the scheme..
documents: related documents such as Khasra and Khatauni Aadhaar card PAN card Udhyan card Bank account details Mobile number
Land-related documents such as Khasra and Khatauni

faqs.question: Who is eligible for this scheme?
faqs.answer: Farmers who are Udhyan Card holders and women members of self-help groups with their own land or leased land are eligible.

faqs.question: What is the financial assistance provided under this scheme?
faqs.answer: A subsidy of 75% of the cost, up to ₹33,300/- per unit, is provided for setting up vermicompost units, including pit construction and provision of earthworms.

faqs.question: How can an applicant apply for the scheme?
faqs.answer: Applications must be submitted offline at the Horticulture Mobile Squad Centres.

faqs.question: How is the approval communicated to the applicant?
faqs.answer: Upon acceptance, the district officer sends an approval letter to the farmer and informs them via phone.

faqs.question: What happens after approval of the application?
faqs.answer: The establishment of the vermicompost unit is carried out in the presence of departmental officials.

faqs.question: How is the subsidy disbursed?
faqs.answer: After verification, the subsidy is disbursed directly into the beneficiary’s bank account.

name: Kisan-Vaigyanik Sangoshthi
description: The scheme “Kisan-Vaigyanik Sangoshthi” is implemented by the Uttarakhand Council for Biotechnology under the Department of Agriculture, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to guide farmers and youth in biotechnology-based farming and animal husbandry by providing technical training and solutions to enhance self-employment and income generation.
benefits: Through Kisan-Vaigyanik Sangoshthi, the Council provides technical guidance from subject matter experts to the state’s farmers, helping to address challenges in biotechnology-based agriculture and animal husbandry. The Council also continuously works to improve farmers’ livelihoods and promote self-employment by sharing technical knowledge on hydroponics, soilless farming, kiwifruit cultivation, fish farming, beekeeping, vegetable production, and floriculture.
eligibility: The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand.. The applicant must be a youth, a farmer, a member of a self-help group, or a livestock farmer..
documents: Documents are required as per the guidelines of the Uttarakhand Council for Biotechnology for participation in the seminars.

faqs.question: Who can participate in the scheme?
faqs.answer: Participation is open to youth, farmers, members of self-help groups, and livestock farmers from Uttarakhand.

faqs.question: How are participants informed about the seminars?
faqs.answer: Participants are informed through brochures, leaflets, and social media channels.

faqs.question: How are participants registered?
faqs.answer: Interested candidates are registered after receiving information about the seminars, either online or through designated registration centers.

faqs.question: What topics are covered in the seminars?
faqs.answer: Seminars cover hydroponics, soilless farming, kiwifruit cultivation, fish farming, beekeeping, vegetable production, floriculture, and other biotechnology-based agriculture and animal husbandry techniques.

faqs.question: Can students participate in these seminars?
faqs.answer: Yes, students associated with agriculture or biotechnology can also participate in the seminars.

name: Financial Assistance to Boat owner / Fishermen Captured by Pakistan Marine Security Agency (PMSA)-DNH&DD
state: Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
description: The scheme “Financial Assistance to Boat owner / Fishermen Captured by Pakistan Marine Security Agency (PMSA)” has been implemented by the Department of Fisheries, UT Administration of Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu. The scheme aims to help the families of the fishermen affected due to captured by Pakistani Marine Security Agency. Ameliorate the hardship due to apprehension/detention of the fishing vessel, by providing one time back ended financial assistance to the registered and licensed fishing vessel owners operating from the Union Territory to re-construct/replace their fishing boat/engine etc.
benefits: > Pattern of Assistance: Unskilled daily wages rate as notified time to time by the U. T. Administration to the families of the Fishermen those are held 1s time captive/detained by Pakistani Marine Security Agency (PMSA), having valid ID Cards and resident of U.T. of Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu. T.A./D.A. to the fishermen during the repatriations from Pakistani Jail:- Travelling Allowance (T.A.) is admissible at 2nd class Sleeper of Railways Fair. Daily Allowance (D.A.) of ₹250/- per day per person is admissible during repatriation. One time financial Assistance in the form of back ended subsidy to the registered boat owner of the U.T. of Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu to re-construct/ replace their fishing vessels by new fishing vessels @ 25% maximum up to ₹ 10.00 lakh, with waiting period of five years.
eligibility: The applicant must be a resident of the Union Territory of Dadra &. Nagar Haveli and Daman &. The applicant must be a boat owner or fisherman captured by the Pakistan Marine Security Agency (PMSA), or a family member thereof..
documents: Identity proof Passport size photograph Residence proof Bank account details Ration Card Any other documents (As per requirement)

faqs.question: Who is the primary objective of this scheme intended to help?
faqs.answer: The scheme is designed to help the families of fishermen and boat owners who are facing hardships due to being apprehended or detained by the PMSA.

faqs.question: Which specific regions must a fishing vessel owner operate from to be eligible for the back-ended financial assistance to replace a boat?
faqs.answer: Registered and licensed fishing vessel owners must be operating specifically from the Union Territory of Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu.

faqs.question: What is the primary purpose of the one-time back-ended financial assistance provided to vessel owners under this scheme?
faqs.answer: The assistance is provided to help owners reconstruct or replace their fishing boats or engines after they have been captured.

faqs.question: How much daily financial assistance is provided to the families of fishermen held captive by the Pakistani Marine Security Agency?
faqs.answer: Unskilled daily wages rate as notified time to time by the U. T. Administration to the families of the Fishermen those are held 1s time captive/detained by Pakistani Marine Security Agency (PMSA), having valid ID Cards and resident of U.T. of Daman, Diu and DNH only.

faqs.question: Does the scheme provide any support for the actual return or repatriation of fishermen from Pakistani jails?
faqs.answer: Yes, the scheme provides T.A. (Traveling Allowance) and D.A. (Daily Allowance) to fishermen during their repatriation from Pakistani jails.

faqs.question: What class of railway travel is covered under the Traveling Allowance for repatriated fishermen?
faqs.answer: The scheme covers the cost of a 2nd class Sleeper railway fare for fishermen returning from Pakistani jails.

faqs.question: What is the maximum percentage of subsidy offered for the reconstruction or replacement of a fishing vessel?
faqs.answer: The scheme offers a back-ended subsidy of 25% for the reconstruction or replacement of fishing vessels.

faqs.question: What is the maximum monetary limit or cap on the subsidy provided for a new fishing vessel?
faqs.answer: The maximum financial assistance for a new fishing vessel is capped at a total amount of ₹10.00 lakhs.

faqs.question: Which specific regions must a fishing vessel owner operate from to be eligible for the vessel replacement subsidy?
faqs.answer: To be eligible for the boat replacement subsidy, the registered and licensed fishing vessel owners must be operating from Union Territory of Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu.

name: Financial Assistance to Brackish Water Aquaculture Farms
description: “Financial Assistance to Brackish Water Aquaculture Farms” is a scheme by the Department of Fisheries, Government of Goa. Through this scheme, financial assistance is provided to eligible fishermen for the construction and renovation of the Farm, for the purchase of farming equipment, and for the purchase of feed. Only the farmers having a water spread area of 2 hectares or less can apply to this scheme. The applications are accepted only in offline mode.
benefits: > Financial Assistance for Construction & Renovation of Farm 25% subsidy, limited to ₹2,00,000 per hectare. > Financial Assistance for Purchase of Farming Equipment 50% subsidy, limited to ₹1,00,000 per hectare. > Financial Assistance for the Purchase of Feed 25% subsidy of the cost of feed, limited to ₹30,000 per crop per hectare for 2 crops in a year.
eligibility: The applicant should be a farmer having a water spread area of 2 hectares or less.. The farms owned by the applicant should be licensed by the Coastal Aquaculture Authority.
documents: Joint Photograph of Applicant With Spouse. Aadhaar Card/ration Card. CAA License Copy. Mandate Form. Copy of Estimate of Work. Work Completion Certificate of the Farm.
Joint Photograph of Applicant With Spouse.
Work Completion Certificate of the Farm.

faqs.question: Can the Financial Assistance for Purchase of Feed be availed for more than two crops in a year?
faqs.answer: No, the assistance is limited to [?]30,000 per crop per hectare for 2 crops in a year.

faqs.question: What is the contact information for the Grievance Redressal Officer, and is there a dedicated email for lodging grievances?
faqs.answer: The Grievance Redressal Officer can be contacted at dir-fish.goa@nic.in.

faqs.question: Can applicants submit applications at any time, or are there specific windows for submission?
faqs.answer: The guidelines do not specify specific windows; applications can presumably be submitted at any time.

faqs.question: What documents are required for the application, and are self-attested copies acceptable?
faqs.answer: Required documents include a joint photograph, Aadhar Card, CAA License Copy, Mandate Form, Estimate of Work, and Work Completion Certificate, all of which should be self-attested if required.

faqs.question: Is the submission of applications limited to offline mode, and where should the filled application forms be submitted?
faqs.answer: Yes, applications are accepted only in offline mode, and forms should be submitted to the Directorate of Fisheries in Panaji Goa or BDO Office/Sub-Offices.

faqs.question: How is the subsidy for the Financial Assistance for Purchase of Farming Equipment calculated, and what is the maximum limit per hectare?
faqs.answer: The subsidy is 50%, limited to [?]1,00,000 per hectare.

faqs.question: What is the maximum subsidy limit for the Financial Assistance for Construction & Renovation of Farm under this scheme?
faqs.answer: The subsidy limit is 25%, capped at [?]2,00,000 per hectare.

faqs.question: Are there any fees associated with the application process for this scheme, considering the department's website does not mention an application fee?
faqs.answer: No, the application fee is nil.

faqs.question: Could you provide details on the eligibility criteria, specifically regarding the water spread area for farmers to apply to this scheme?
faqs.answer: Farmers with a water spread area of 2 hectares or less are eligible to apply.

faqs.question: Is there a specific timeframe within which farmers must utilize the financial assistance provided for the purchase of feed?
faqs.answer: The guidelines do not specify a timeframe for utilizing the financial assistance for feed purchase.

faqs.question: Can farmers apply for financial assistance for both construction and renovation of farms and the purchase of farming equipment simultaneously?
faqs.answer: Yes, eligible farmers can apply for assistance in both categories simultaneously.

faqs.question: Is the financial assistance provided under this scheme subject to taxation, and are there any deductions or exemptions mentioned?
faqs.answer: The guidelines do not provide information on the taxation status of the financial assistance, and any related deductions or exemptions are not specified.

name: Financial Assistance for Construction/ Purchase of Wooden/ FRP Fishing Vessel (Canoe) for Fishermen
description: The scheme “Financial Assistance for Construction/ Purchase of Wooden/ FRP Fishing Vessel (Canoe) for Fishermen” is a scheme by the Department of Fisheries, Government of Goa. Through this scheme, 50% of the actual cost of the Wooden/ Fiber-Reinforced Plastic (FRP) Fishing Vessel (Canoe) purchased by the fishermen is covered by the Government of Goa. The applicant will be entitled to a subsidy grant once every four years on one craft per family household.
benefits: For General Category, 50% subsidy, limited to ₹ 60,000/- - For SC/ST Category, 50% subsidy, limited to ₹ 80,000/- The applicant will be entitled to a subsidy grant once every four years on one craft per family household.
eligibility: The applicant should be a traditional fisherman by birth or profession.. The applicant should be a resident of Goa.. The applicant or any member of his household should not be a defaulter with the Directorate of Fisheries, Goa.. The canoe purchased through the scheme should be duly registered with the Directorate of Fisheries under the Marine Fishing Regulation Act (MFR) Act 1980/ Merchant Shipping (MS) Act.. The applicant shall not sell, lease, mortgage, or transfer the wooden/ FRP craft for 5 years from the date of purchase of the said wooden/FRP craft.. The wooden/FRP craft purchased should have been operated exclusively for fishing purposes only..
documents: Certificate of Vessel Registration, issued by the Directorate of Fisheries, Government of Goa, under the Merchant Shipping Act

Fishing Vessel License Certificate Fishing Net License Certificate. Copy of Fishing Netbook (Updated) Original GST Bill from the Authorized Dealer towards the Construction of the Wooden / FRP Craft. Caste Certificate (ST/ SC) if applicable. Copy of Aadhar Card Copy of Election Card Copy of Bank Passbook/Statement (Aadhaar linked) Bank letter (if bank financed) Inspection Report along with photographs of Fishing Canoe, Net, and its Accessories by Fisheries Superintendent/ Fisheries Officer, Assistant Superintendent of Fisheries (As per format).
Certificate of Vessel Registration, issued by the Directorate of Fisheries, Government of Goa, under the Merchant Shipping Act 1958.
Original GST Bill from the Authorized Dealer towards the Construction of the Wooden / FRP Craft.
Inspection Report along with photographs of Fishing Canoe, Net, and its Accessories by Fisheries Superintendent/ Fisheries Officer, Assistant Superintendent of Fisheries (As per format).

faqs.question: Can the Fishing Canoe be financed through a bank, and what documents are required in such cases?
faqs.answer: Yes, bank financing is allowed. Documents include the bank passbook/statement (Aadhaar linked) and a bank letter if financed by the bank.

faqs.question: Is it mandatory to possess a fishing vessel (trawler/purse-seiner) for eligibility, and what is the default status criterion?
faqs.answer: Applicants and their family members should not possess a fishing vessel (trawler/purse-seiner) and should not be defaulters of the Fisheries Department.

faqs.question: How does the applicant affirm the purpose of using the Wooden/FRP Canoe and Nets purchased through the scheme?
faqs.answer: The applicant declares the intended use for fishing activity only in the self-declaration.

faqs.question: Can you elaborate on the self-declaration process and the specific declarations required from the applicant?
faqs.answer: The self-declaration covers ownership, subsidy history, family members' details, usage of the Canoe, absence of fishing vessel registration, and non-default status.

faqs.question: What role does the Inspection Report play, and what details does it encompass?
faqs.answer: The Inspection Report includes details on the Canoe's registration, owner, fishing details, engine, nets, life-saving equipment, ice box, and overall status.

faqs.question: What is the inspection process, and who conducts the inspection for the Fishing Canoe under this scheme?
faqs.answer: Inspection is done by the Fisheries Superintendent/Officer, Assistant Superintendent of Fisheries, as per the specified format.

faqs.question: What are the contact details for the Directorate of Fisheries in Goa, and how can applicants reach out for inquiries?
faqs.answer: The contact details are Dayanand Bandodkar Marg, Panaji Goa; Tel: (O) 2224838, (Dir) 2227780; Email: dir-fish.goa@nic.in; Website: www.fisheries.goa.gov.in.

faqs.question: Can you provide details about the required Life Saving Equipments and Ice Box for the Fishing Canoe?
faqs.answer: Details include Life Buoy, Life Jacket, and specifications for the Ice Box, including liters, number, and cost.

faqs.question: How is the subsidy amount calculated for SC/ST Category beneficiaries, and what is their maximum limit?
faqs.answer: SC/ST Category beneficiaries receive a 50% subsidy, limited to [?]80,000 under the scheme.

faqs.question: What are the prerequisites for the Wooden/FRP craft to be considered for subsidy, particularly regarding its usage?
faqs.answer: The wooden/FRP craft purchased should have been operated exclusively for fishing purposes.

faqs.question: What are the criteria for eligibility regarding the applicant's default status with the Directorate of Fisheries, Goa?
faqs.answer: The applicant or any household member should not be a defaulter with the Directorate of Fisheries, Goa.

faqs.question: What restrictions are placed on the sale or transfer of the purchased wooden/FRP craft, and for how long?
faqs.answer: The applicant cannot sell, lease, mortgage, or transfer the craft for five years from the date of purchase under the scheme.

faqs.question: Can a non-resident of Goa apply for the scheme, and what specific residency criteria must an applicant meet?
faqs.answer: No, only residents of Goa are eligible. The applicant must be a traditional fisherman by birth or profession and a resident of Goa.

faqs.question: How often can an applicant receive a subsidy grant for a craft under this scheme, and what is the specified time frame?
faqs.answer: An applicant is entitled to a subsidy grant once every four years for one craft per family household under the scheme.

faqs.question: What is the maximum subsidy limit for the purchase of a Wooden/FRP Fishing Vessel (Canoe) under the scheme for General Category beneficiaries in Goa?
faqs.answer: [?]60,000 is the maximum subsidy limit for General Category beneficiaries under the scheme for purchasing a Wooden/FRP Fishing Vessel (Canoe).

name: Financial Assistance To Dairy Farmers Belonging To Scheduled Tribes And Scheduled Caste For Purchase Of Basic Dairy Equipments
description: The scheme "Financial Assistance to Dairy Farmers Belonging to Scheduled Tribes and Scheduled Caste for Purchase of Basic Dairy Equipments" was launched by the Department of Animal Husbandry & Veterinary Services, Government of Goa. The scheme aims to provide assistance to the Scheduled Tribes and Scheduled Caste communities for the purchase of basic dairy equipments needed to run a small scale dairy farming, and to encourage the tribal population to adopt Animal Husbandry activities, especially Dairy Development Schemes. The scheme is implemented by the Directorate of Animal Husbandry & Veterinary Services. The applications for this scheme are accepted offline through the local Veterinary Officer or Assistant Director.
benefits: Maximum Financial Assistance 100% subsidy shall be provided for dairy items of general use. The subsidy is subject to a maximum amount of ₹30,000/- or the actual cost of the items, whichever is lower. The subsidy is a one-time assistance per family. Maximum Permissible Subsidy per Item Stainless Steel Cans (Twenty liters Capacity): ₹3,800/- (for 2 permissible units). Liters Water Tanks: ₹3,500/- (for 1 permissible unit). Calf Nipple Bucket: ₹1,500/- (for 1 permissible unit). Spray Pump 15 Liters Capacity: ₹2,000/- (for 1 permissible unit). Steel Buckets: ₹2,200/- (for 2 permissible units). 5 Horsepower water Pump: ₹5,000/- (for 1 permissible unit). Ceiling Fans: ₹4,000/- (for 2 permissible units). Steel Vessels 5 Liters Capacity: ₹900/- (for 2 permissible units). Spade: ₹250/- (for 1 permissible unit). Grooming Brush: ₹400/- (for 2 permissible units). Gamelas: ₹500/- (for 2 permissible units). Nylon Rope: ₹400/- (for 2.5 kilograms). Sickle: ₹250/- (for 1 permissible unit). Pickaxe: ₹300/- (for 1 permissible unit). Rubber mat: ₹5,000/- (for 2 permissible units). Benefit Disbursal Subsidy shall be directly credited to the beneficiary’s bank account. In case of limited purchase of dairy items, proportionate subsidy shall be released. The Department will release the subsidy within 60 days of receiving the documents completed in all respects. Conditions The beneficiary must use the dairy equipments purchased for the development of their dairy unit. The beneficiary shall abide by the provision of the said scheme, and undertake to comply with the Pattern of Assistance of the scheme as contained in the scheme. The beneficiary must use the dairy equipments for a minimum period of 3 (three) years from the date of purchase, subject to normal wear and tear. The beneficiary solemnly undertakes to refund the cost of the items if the items are found misutilised or missing. In case of breach of any clause, the Government is free to recover the subsidy released through any due benefits under other eligible schemes of the Directorate of Animal Husbandry & Veterinary Services and/or under the land revenue code.
eligibility: The applicant must be a resident of Goa for at least five preceding years.. The applicant must belong to the Scheduled Tribe or Scheduled Caste Community.. The applicant must be a Dairy Farmer.. The applicant must have at least two milch animals.. The two milch animals must be Local Cows, Indigenous cows, Cross Bred cows, Local Buffaloes, or Improved Buffaloes..
documents: During Application Caste Certificate Issued by Competent Authority. Aadhar Consent Form Duly Filled In. Five Years Residential Certificate. Two Passport Size Photographs of the Applicant. Prescribed Affidavit Duly Notarised (Used to declare non

availment of subsidy under any Government scheme for the applied items). Copy of Ration Card. Copy of Bank Passbook. Information of Existing Milch Animals (Details of Cross Bred Cow/Improved She Buffalo, Local/Non

Descript Adult Heifers, and Young Female Calves) (Required on the application form). During Benefit Disbursal Original Purchase Receipts or Bills (Must be submitted within 90 days of application approval).
Caste Certificate Issued by Competent Authority.
Aadhar Consent Form Duly Filled In.
Two Passport Size Photographs of the Applicant.
Prescribed Affidavit Duly Notarised (Used to declare non-availment of subsidy under any Government scheme for the applied items).
Information of Existing Milch Animals (Details of Cross Bred Cow/Improved She Buffalo, Local/Non-Descript Adult Heifers, and Young Female Calves) (Required on the application form).
Original Purchase Receipts or Bills (Must be submitted within 90 days of application approval).

faqs.question: What specific community criteria must be fulfilled by the applicant to be considered eligible for this financial assistance program?
faqs.answer: The applicant must belong to either the Scheduled Tribes Community or the Scheduled Caste Community to qualify for this particular scheme.

faqs.question: Following the approval of the initial application, what is the required timeframe for the beneficiary to submit the original purchase documents for the equipment?
faqs.answer: After the application is approved, the beneficiary is mandated to submit the original purchase receipts or bills to the local Assistant Director or Veterinary Officer within 90 days.

faqs.question: For how long is an applicant required to have maintained continuous residency within the state of Goa prior to submitting their application?
faqs.answer: Applicants must demonstrate that they have been a resident of the state of Goa for a minimum of 5 preceding years immediately before applying.

faqs.question: If the procured items are later discovered to be missing or utilized for purposes other than the intended dairy development, what are the financial consequences?
faqs.answer: The beneficiary provides a solemn undertaking to refund the full cost of the items if they are subsequently found to be either misutilised or completely missing during verification.

faqs.question: What specific rules or guidelines must the beneficiary agree to adhere to once the grant of subsidy has been officially provided by the Government?
faqs.answer: In consideration of the subsidy grant, the beneficiary shall abide by all the provisions of the scheme and comply fully with the stipulated Pattern of Assistance.

faqs.question: What is the minimum mandatory number of milch animals an applicant must own, and what types of animals satisfy this requirement?
faqs.answer: The applicant must possess at least 2 milch animals. These can be Local Cows, Indigenous cows, Cross Bred cows, Local Buffaloes, or Improved Buffaloes.

faqs.question: If I have previously received governmental support for dairy equipment, does that prevent me from receiving assistance for new items under this program?
faqs.answer: The applicant must not have availed subsidy under any scheme of the Government of Goa for the specific equipments for which they are currently applying.

faqs.question: Is there a mandatory length of time the beneficiary must commit to keeping and actively using the subsidized dairy equipments?
faqs.answer: Yes, the beneficiary is required to use the dairy equipments for a minimum period of 3 (three) years from the date of purchase, accounting for normal wear and tear.

faqs.question: Once all required documentation, including purchase bills, has been verified and found complete, how long will it take for the subsidy to be released?
faqs.answer: The Department of Animal Husbandry & Veterinary Services will release the approved subsidy directly to the beneficiary’s bank account within 60 days of receiving all completed documents.

faqs.question: What is the highest total financial support I can expect to receive under this assistance program for purchasing necessary dairy equipment?
faqs.answer: A 100% subsidy shall be provided for dairy items, subject to a maximum amount of ₹30,000/- (Rupees thirty thousand only) or the actual cost of the items, whichever amount is lower.

faqs.question: Are there any processing charges or monetary fees associated with the preparation and official submission of the application form for this assistance?
faqs.answer: No processing fee or monetary charges shall be levied or collected from the applicant for the submission of the application under this scheme.

faqs.question: Through which specific local government officials or offices should the completed application form and all supporting documents be submitted?
faqs.answer: Applications must be submitted in duplicate through the local Veterinary Officer or the Assistant Director of the Department of Animal Husbandry & Veterinary Services.

faqs.question: If I breach any of the scheme's clauses, how is the Government authorized to recover the released subsidy amount from me?
faqs.answer: In the event of a breach, the Government is free to recover the subsidy through any due benefits under other eligible schemes of the Directorate of Animal Husbandry & Veterinary Services or under the land revenue code.

faqs.question: After receiving the financial assistance and purchasing the items, what is the primary purpose for which the dairy equipment must be utilized?
faqs.answer: The applicant solemnly undertakes to use the purchased dairy equipments exclusively for the purpose of the development and operation of their dairy unit.

name: Fruit Area Expansion
description: The scheme “Fruit Area Expansion” is implemented by the Department of Horticulture, Government of Uttarakhand. It aims to increase fruit production by encouraging farmers to establish new orchards, providing fruit plants at a 50% subsidy to support the expansion of fruit cultivation across Uttarakhand.
benefits: Increasing production by establishing new orchards. Fruit plants are provided at a subsidy of 50% of the total cost. For developing orchards, fruit plants such as mango, guava, pomegranate, apple, litchi, plum, peach, apricot, walnut, citrus, malta, kiwi, dragon fruit, etc., are provided to farmers. (For example, if a walnut plant costs ₹400/-, the farmer has to deposit ₹200/- at the concerned Horticulture Mobile team Centre, and the government bears the remaining ₹200/- as subsidy, so the farmer receives the plant for ₹200/-.)
eligibility: The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand.. The applicant must be a farmer and hold a Udhyan Card.. The farmer must either own agricultural land or have land on lease.. If the farmer owns land, the maximum land allowed per beneficiary is 4 hectares and the minimum land allowed is 0.02 hectares.. The maximum land area allowed under the scheme is 4 hectares..
documents: related documents, such as Khasra and Khatauni (lease certificate, in case of leased land) Aadhaar Card PAN Card Udhyan Card Bank account details Mobile Number Other supporting documents as required
Land-related documents, such as Khasra and Khatauni (lease certificate, in case of leased land)

faqs.question: Who is eligible to apply for the scheme?
faqs.answer: Farmers who own or lease agricultural land and hold a Udhyan Card are eligible.

faqs.question: What is the maximum and minimum land allowed per beneficiary?
faqs.answer: The minimum land allowed is 0.02 hectares, and the maximum is 4 hectares per beneficiary.

faqs.question: Which fruit plants are provided under the scheme?
faqs.answer: Fruit plants like mango, guava, pomegranate, apple, litchi, plum, peach, apricot, walnut, citrus, Malta, kiwi, dragon fruit, and others are provided.

faqs.question: What is the subsidy provided for fruit plants?
faqs.answer: A 50% subsidy is provided. For example, if a plant costs ₹400/-, the farmer pays ₹200/-, and the government bears ₹200/-.

faqs.question: How can farmers obtain the application form?
faqs.answer: Forms can be obtained from officers or staff at Horticulture Mobile Squad Centre.

faqs.question: When should applications be submitted for winter planting?
faqs.answer: Applications for winter planting should be submitted between September and October.

faqs.question: When should applications be submitted for rainy season planting?
faqs.answer: Applications for rainy season planting should be submitted between April and June.

faqs.question: Where should farmers submit their applications?
faqs.answer: Farmers must submit their completed applications along with all documents to the Horticulture Mobile Squad Centre.

faqs.question: How are applications processed for centrally funded schemes?
faqs.answer: After submission, the Horticulture Mobile Squad Centre sends the proposal to the district level, then to the state level, and finally to the Government of India. Once approved, targets are communicated back to the district level via the Directorate.

faqs.question: How are applications processed for state-sponsored schemes?
faqs.answer: Applications are sent from the Horticulture Mobile Squad Centre to the district, then to the Directorate. After approval, work orders are issued to districts as per the Government Order.

faqs.question: How does a farmer know if their proposal is approved?
faqs.answer: The district officer sends an acceptance letter and also informs the farmer by phone.

name: Flower Area Expansion
description: The “Flower Area Expansion” scheme is implemented by the Department of Horticulture, Government of Uttarakhand. It aims to promote and expand flower cultivation by providing cultivators in Uttarakhand access to quality flower planting material at a subsidized cost, thereby increasing flower production and enhancing farmers’ income.
benefits: To encourage flower production, flower planting material (bulbs, plants, and seeds) is provided to cultivators at a 50% subsidy on the total cost, applicable for a maximum area of 4 hectares, as follows: For open flowers, planting material worth up to ₹20,000/- per hectare is provided. For stalked flowers, planting material worth up to ₹50,000/- per hectare is provided. For bulbous flowers, planting material worth up to ₹75,000/- per hectare is provided. (For example, if 1 kg of marigold seeds costs ₹200/-, the cultivator pays ₹100/- at the Horticulture Mobile team Center, while the government provides a subsidy of ₹100/-, allowing the cultivator to obtain the seeds for ₹100/-.)
eligibility: The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand.. The applicant must be a farmer and hold a Udhyan Card.. The farmer must either own agricultural land or have land on lease..
documents: related documents, such as Khasra and Khatauni (lease certificate, in case of leased land) Aadhaar Card PAN Card Udhyan Card Bank account details Mobile Number Other supporting documents as required
Land-related documents, such as Khasra and Khatauni (lease certificate, in case of leased land)

faqs.question: Who is eligible for this scheme?
faqs.answer: Farmers in Uttarakhand who own land or cultivate on leased land and hold a valid Udhyan Card are eligible.

faqs.question: What types of flower planting material are provided under the scheme?
faqs.answer: The scheme provides bulbs, plants, and seeds for open flowers, stalked flowers, and bulbous flowers.

faqs.question: What is the subsidy offered under this scheme?
faqs.answer: The scheme provides a 50% subsidy on the cost of flower planting material.

faqs.question: Is there a maximum area for which the subsidy is applicable?
faqs.answer: Yes, the subsidy is applicable for a maximum of 4 hectares per cultivator.

faqs.question: Where can application forms be obtained?
faqs.answer: Forms can be obtained from officers or staff at the Horticulture Mobile Squad Centre or downloaded from department's website.

faqs.question: When should applications be submitted?
faqs.answer: For winter planting, submit between September and October. For the rainy season, submit between April and June.

faqs.question: How are centrally funded scheme applications processed?
faqs.answer: Applications are sent from the Horticulture Mobile Squad Centre to the district level, then to the state level, and onward to the Government of India. After approval, targets are communicated back to the districts.

faqs.question: How are state-sponsored scheme applications processed?
faqs.answer: Applications are sent from the Horticulture Mobile Squad Centre to the district, then to the Directorate. After approval, a work order is issued to the districts as per the Government Order.

faqs.question: How will a farmer know if their application is approved?
faqs.answer: Once approved, the district officer sends an acceptance letter and informs the farmer over the phone.

name: Financial Assistance To Fishermen For Purchase of Fisheries Requisites (Gill Net/ River Gill Net with Accessories)
description: The scheme “ Financial Assistance To Fishermen For Purchase of Fisheries Requisites (Gill Net/ River Gill Net with Accessories)” is a scheme by the Department of Fisheries, Government of Goa. Through this scheme, a 50% subsidy is provided to the fishermen of Goa for the purchase of fisheries requisites (gill nets with accessories).
benefits: For General Category: 50% subsidy limited to ₹ 30,000/- .- For SC/ST Category: 50% subsidy limited to ₹ 40,000/- .
eligibility: The applicant should be a traditional fisherman by birth or profession.. The applicant should be a resident of Goa.. The applicant should or any of his households should not be defaulters with the Directorate of Fisheries.. The applicant should possess their own registered fishing canoe.. The original VAT bill may be submitted by the applicant from the authorized dealer to claim the subsidy.. The applicant shall not sell, lease, or transfer the Gill Net for five years from the date of purchase of the first Gill Net.. The fishing net shall be duly registered with the Directorate of Fisheries..
documents: Certificate of Vessel Registration, issued by the Directorate of Fisheries, Government of Goa, under the Merchant Shipping Act

Fishing Vessel License Certificate Fishing Net License Certificate. Copy of Fishing Netbook (Updated) Original GST Bill from the Authorized Dealer towards the Construction of the Wooden / FRP Craft. Caste Certificate (ST/ SC) if applicable. Copy of Aadhar Card Copy of Election Card Copy of Bank Passbook/Statement (Aadhaar linked) Bank letter (if bank financed) Inspection Report along with photographs of Fishing Canoe, Net, and its Accessories by Fisheries Superintendent/ Fisheries Officer, Assistant Superintendent of Fisheries ( As per format ).
Certificate of Vessel Registration, issued by the Directorate of Fisheries, Government of Goa, under the Merchant Shipping Act 1958.
Original GST Bill from the Authorized Dealer towards the Construction of the Wooden / FRP Craft.

Inspection Report along with photographs of Fishing Canoe, Net, and its Accessories by Fisheries Superintendent/ Fisheries Officer, Assistant Superintendent of Fisheries (As per format (https://fisheries.goa.gov.in/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/Gill-Net-Application-Forms.pdf)).

faqs.question: Can the applicant claim the subsidy without submitting the original VAT bill?
faqs.answer: No, the original VAT bill must be submitted by the applicant from the authorized dealer to claim the subsidy.

faqs.question: What is the subsidy limit for SC/ST Category under the mentioned scheme?
faqs.answer: For SC/ST Category, the subsidy is 50%, limited to [?]40,000.

faqs.question: Is there a specific contact point for registering dissatisfaction or complaints about the scheme's services?
faqs.answer: Register complaints with the Departments Grievance Redressal Officer or through the link dir-fish.goa@nic.in.

faqs.question: What is the duration for which the applicant cannot sell, lease, or transfer the Gill Net after purchase?
faqs.answer: The fishing net cannot be sold, leased, or transferred for five years from the date of its purchase.

faqs.question: Can an applicant submit the application form and documents through an online platform?
faqs.answer: No, the application form and documents must be submitted physically to the Directorate of Fisheries or specified sub-offices.

faqs.question: What role do Fisheries Superintendent and Fisheries Officer play in the application process?
faqs.answer: They conduct inspections and provide an inspection report with photographs of the Fishing Canoe, Net, and its Accessories as per the specified format.

faqs.question: In the event of a change in the applicant's residential address during the scheme period, what steps should be taken?
faqs.answer: The applicant must inform the concerned authority at the Directorate of Fisheries promptly about any change in residential address.

faqs.question: Are there specific income criteria for eligibility, and what are they?
faqs.answer: There is no income criteria for this scheme.

faqs.question: Is there any application fee or cost associated with applying for this scheme?
faqs.answer: The entire application process is entirely free of cost. There are no application fees.

faqs.question: Is There Any Compensation For The Delay In The Disbursal Of The Scheme Benefits?
faqs.answer: The guidelines do not mention any provision for compensation in the event of delayed disbursement of scheme benefits. Applicants should note that compensation for delays is not part of the scheme's framework.

faqs.question: Is It Mandatory to Have a Bank Account for This Scheme?
faqs.answer: Yes, possession of a valid bank account is a mandatory requirement for participation in this scheme.

name: Financial Assistance to the Fish Vendors Registered with the Directorate of Fisheries to Purchase the Accessories Required for Fish Vending
description: “Financial Assistance to the Fish Vendors Registered with the Directorate of Fisheries to Purchase the Accessories Required for Fish Vending” is a scheme by the Department of Fisheries, Government of Goa. Under this scheme, Financial Assistance is provided to the fish vendors for the purchase of Crates, Weighing Balance, Insulated Box, Gloves, Stools, Platforms to keep Fish/ Shed/ Umbrella, Choppers, and Other Equipment related to Fish Vendor, so that the fish can be reached to the people in hygienic conditions. benefits: > For General Category 50% subsidy, limited to ₹10,000, on a unit cost of ₹20,000. > For SC/ST/Woman Category 60% subsidy, limited to ₹12,000, on a unit cost of ₹20,000. NOTE: The beneficiary can avail of the scheme once every three years.

documents: Original Invoice from registered dealers for the purchase of accessories required for Fish Vending. Identity Card (Fish Vendor) issued by the Department of Fisheries, Government of Goa. Copy of Aadhaar Card. Mandate Form along with Bank Pass Book.
Original Invoice from registered dealers for the purchase of accessories required for Fish Vending.
Identity Card (Fish Vendor) issued by the Department of Fisheries, Government of Goa.
Mandate Form along with Bank Pass Book.

faqs.question: What is the primary focus of the "Financial Assistance to the Fish Vendors" scheme in Goa?
faqs.answer: The scheme provides financial assistance to registered fish vendors for purchasing accessories such as crates, weighing balance, insulated box, gloves, stool, platform, choppers, and other fish vending-related equipment.

faqs.question: What percentage of subsidy is provided to the General Category under the scheme, and what is the maximum limit?
faqs.answer: The General Category receives a 50% subsidy, capped at [?]10,000, on a unit cost of [?]20,000.

faqs.question: Can a beneficiary in the SC/ST/Woman category avail of the scheme more than once within a three-year period?
faqs.answer: No, the scheme allows beneficiaries to avail financial assistance only once every three years.

faqs.question: How can a fish vendor apply for the scheme, and what is the application fee?
faqs.answer: Interested applicants can request the prescribed application form by paying [?]50 to the Department of Fisheries.

faqs.question: What is the address for submitting the filled application form and documents?

faqs.question: Is there any age restriction or specific criteria for Persons with Disabilities (PwDs) in this scheme?
faqs.answer: No, there are no age-related criteria, and there are no specific criteria for Persons with Disabilities (PwDs).

faqs.question: Can applications be submitted online, and what is the deadline for application submission?
faqs.answer: Applications are accepted only in offline mode, and there is no specified deadline for submission.

faqs.question: How much time does the Department take to address grievances, and where can complaints be lodged?

faqs.question: What is the contact information for the Directorate of Fisheries in Goa?

faqs.question: What equipment is covered under the scheme for fish vendors?
faqs.answer: The scheme covers the purchase of crates, weighing balance, insulated box, gloves, stool, platform, choppers, and other equipment related to fish vending.

faqs.question: What is the unit cost for the accessories covered under the scheme?
faqs.answer: The unit cost for the accessories is [?]20,000.

faqs.question: How is the subsidy amount calculated for the SC/ST/Woman category?
faqs.answer: The SC/ST/Woman category receives a 60% subsidy, capped at [?]12,000, on a unit cost of [?]20,000.

name: Financial Assistance to Fresh Water Aquaculture Farms
description: “Financial Assistance to Fresh Water Aquaculture Farms” is a scheme by the Department of Fisheries, Government of Goa. Through this scheme, financial assistance is provided to eligible fishermen for the construction and renovation of the Farm, for the purchase of farming equipment, and the purchase of feed. benefits: > Financial Assistance for Construction & Renovation of Farm 25% subsidy, limited to ₹2,00,000 per hectare, limited to 2 hectares. > Financial Assistance for Purchase of Farming Equipment 50% subsidy, limited to ₹60,000 (per year) per hectare. > Financial Assistance for Purchase of Feed 25% subsidy of the cost of feed, limited to ₹50,000 (per year) per hectare limited to 2 hectares.
eligibility: The applicant should be a Fish Farmer/ Individual/ Registered Self Help Groups/ Societies/ Associations, interested in freshwater fish/prawn farming in the State of Goa.. The applicant should be a resident of Goa for the last fifteen years..
documents: Joint Photograph of Applicant with Spouse
Work Completion Certificate of the Farm

faqs.question: Are there any restrictions on the type of farming equipment eligible for a 50% subsidy, and is there an annual limit on the subsidy amount for equipment purchase?

faqs.question: What is the contact information for the Grievance Redressal Officer, and how can complaints be lodged via email for prompt acknowledgment?

faqs.question: Where can I obtain the prescribed format for the application form for construction or renovation of freshwater fish/shrimp farms?

faqs.question: Could you clarify the eligibility criteria for individuals or entities interested in applying for financial assistance for freshwater fish/prawn farming in Goa?

faqs.question: What is the percentage of subsidy provided for the construction and renovation of freshwater fish farms, and what is the maximum limit per hectare?

faqs.question: How can I access the guidelines for the "Financial Assistance to Fresh Water Aquaculture Farms" scheme by the Department of Fisheries in Goa?

faqs.question: Can you provide details on the maximum area for which financial assistance can be availed under the scheme, particularly for construction and renovation?

faqs.answer: The subsidy for construction and renovation is 25% per hectare, with a maximum cap of [?]2,00,000 per hectare, limited to 2 hectares.

faqs.question: Can you clarify the subsidy details for the purchase of feed under this scheme?
faqs.answer: The subsidy for feed purchase is 25%, limited to [?]50,000 per hectare per year, with a maximum of 2 hectares.

name: Farmers Accidental Insurance Scheme
department: Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department
description: The "Farmers Accidental Insurance Scheme" introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department, Gujarat, aims to provide financial aid to the successors of registered farmers in case of accidental death or disability. The scheme does not cover natural or suicidal deaths.
benefits: Particular Benefit (₹) 1. Accidental death/ 100% permanent Disability₹2,00,000/-2. In case of Accidently Loss of two eyes or two limbs or Hand and leg₹2,00,000/-3. In case of Accidently Loss of one eye and one limb₹2,00,000/-4. In case of Accidently Loss of one eye or one limb₹2,00,000/-
eligibility: The applicant or their parent must have a registered land record before the date of the accident.. The death or disability must be caused by an accident.. The deceased/disabled person must be the registered farmer, their spouse, or any legal heir (son/daughter).. The applicant must possess a valid driving license in case of death/injury (For vehicular accident).. The beneficiary must be between 5 to 70 years of age (For accidental death or permanent disability).. Application should be made in the office of the concerned District Agriculture Officer within 150 days..
documents: A & hack Patrak (Form no: 6). Copy of Post Mortem report I.R & spot Panchami Police Inquest Report or Court Order Proof of death (Death Certificate) & age from competent authority as the case may be. Disability certificate form competent authority, in the case of disablement. Sub Divisional Magistrate report and Police tapas report Baydhari patrak in prescribe Performa. Valid driving licence (in case deceaseddrive the vehicle) In case of first legal heir (son/daughter) Death or disability produce Registered farmer’s (his father or mother) Pedhinamu or successive generations proof.
I.R & spot Panchami Police Inquest Report or Court Order
Proof of death (Death Certificate) & age from competent authority as the case may be.
Disability certificate form competent authority, in the case of disablement.
Sub Divisional Magistrate report and Police tapas report
Valid driving licence (in case deceaseddrive the vehicle)
In case of first legal heir (son/daughter) Death or disability produce Registered farmer’s (his father or mother) Pedhinamu or successive generations proof.

faqs.question: What is the objective of this scheme?
faqs.answer: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to the families of registered farmers in the event of accidental death or disability. The scheme covers the registered farmer, their spouse, and their legal heirs.

faqs.question: Who is eligible to apply for this scheme?
faqs.answer: Any registered farmer in Gujarat, their spouse, or their legal heir (son or daughter) is eligible to apply if they meet the scheme's criteria.

faqs.question: What type of deaths are covered under this scheme?
faqs.answer: The scheme covers only accidental deaths. Natural deaths and suicidal deaths are not covered.

faqs.question: What is the maximum financial assistance provided under the scheme?
faqs.answer: The maximum financial assistance provided is [?]2,00,000 in cases of accidental death or 100% permanent disability.

faqs.question: What benefits are provided for partial disabilities?
faqs.answer: [?]2,00,000/- for the loss of both eyes, both limbs, or one hand and one leg. [?]2,00,000/- for the loss of one eye and one limb. [?]1,00,000/- for the loss of one eye or one limb.

faqs.question: What is the time limit for applying for benefits under the scheme?
faqs.answer: The application must be submitted within 150 days from the date of the accident.

faqs.question: Where should the application be submitted?
faqs.answer: The application should be submitted to the concerned District Agriculture Officer.

faqs.question: Can the benefit be claimed by multiple heirs?
faqs.answer: No, the benefit is provided to a single legal heir as per the succession laws.

faqs.question: What happens if the first legal heir is deceased or disabled?
faqs.answer: If the first legal heir is deceased or disabled, another eligible legal heir can claim the benefit as per the Indian Succession Act.

faqs.question: Who can claim the benefit in case of the registered farmer’s death?
faqs.answer: The legal heir of the deceased registered farmer, which includes the spouse (husband or wife) or children (son or daughter), can claim the benefit.

faqs.question: Is it mandatory to have a valid driving license in case of a vehicular accident?
faqs.answer: Yes, if the accidental death or disability occurred due to a vehicular accident, the deceased or injured person must have possessed a valid driving license at the time of the accident.

name: Financial Assistance to Mussel Culture and Oyster Farming in Goa
description: “Financial Assistance to Mussel Culture and Oyster Farming in Goa” is a scheme by the Department of Fisheries, Government of Goa. Through this scheme, financial assistance is provided to eligible fishermen for setting up units in estuarine waters, and in open sea. The applications are accepted only in offline mode.
benefits: > Setting Up of Unit in Estuarine Waters 50% subsidy limited to ₹ 25,000 per unit, maximum for 2 units. Each unit in the estuarine water will be of size 4 meters x 4 meters. > Setting Up of Unit in Open Sea 50% limited to ₹ 40,000 per unit, maximum for 2 units. eligibility: The applicant should be a Fish Farmer/ Individual/ Registered Self Help Groups/ Societies/ Associations, interested in setting up the Mussel Culture/ Oyster Farming Unit in Goa.. The applicant should have undergone a training programme on Mussel Culture/ Oyster Farming organized by the Fisheries Department/ MPEDA/ ICAR/ any other institute..
documents: Documents for the Proof of Availability of Land (if applicable). A. For Owners (i) Copy of the Land Deed. (ii) Form 1 & Form
B. For Lessee (i) NOC from the Land Owner. (ii) Registered Lease Agreement.
Estuarine Unit in River/Open Sea: NOC from Concerned Authority.
Documents for the Proof of Availability of Land (if applicable).

faqs.question: What steps are taken to verify the authenticity of training programs attended by applicants?

faqs.question: Can the subsidy be availed for units exceeding the specified sizes in estuarine waters and open sea?
faqs.answer: No, the subsidy is limited to [?]25,000 and [?]40,000 per unit for specified sizes in estuarine waters and open sea, respectively.

faqs.question: Are there any exceptions to the fifteen-year residency requirement for applicants?
faqs.answer: No exceptions are mentioned; applicants must be residents of Goa for the last fifteen years.

faqs.question: What specific training programs on Mussel Culture/Oyster Farming are recognized by the Fisheries Department for eligibility?
faqs.answer: Training programs organized by the Fisheries Department, MPEDA, ICAR, or any other recognized institute are accepted.

faqs.question: What is the role of the Directorate of Fisheries in this scheme?
faqs.answer: The Directorate oversees the application process and serves as the contact point for applicants.

faqs.question: Can you provide the link to the Citizen Charter for this scheme?
faqs.answer: Certainly, the Citizen Charter is available at https://fisheries.goa.gov.in/wp-content/uploads/2023/07/CitizenCharter-2.pdf.

faqs.question: How many units can an applicant set up, and what are the subsidy limits?
faqs.answer: Applicants can set up a maximum of 2 units, with a subsidy limit of [?]25,000 per unit for estuarine waters and [?]40,000 per unit for open sea.

faqs.question: Is there a prescribed format for the application form, and where can it be obtained?
faqs.answer: Yes, the application form is available at https://fisheries.goa.gov.in/wp-content/uploads/2020/08/Mussel-Oyster-1.pdf.

faqs.question: What are the contact details for the Directorate of Fisheries in Goa?
faqs.answer: Dayanand Bandodkar Marg, Panaji Goa. Tel: (O) 2224838 Tel: (Dir) 2227780; Fax: (0832)2231049. Email: dir-fish.goa@nic.in, Website: www.fisheries.goa.gov.in.

faqs.question: Can you explain the grievance redressal process for this scheme?
faqs.answer: Dissatisfaction or complaints can be registered with the Grievance Redressal Officer at dir-fish.goa@nic.in, and a response will be communicated within 30 days.

faqs.question: Is there a specific format for the passport-sized photograph, and what should be the size?
faqs.answer: Photographs should be passport-sized, signed across if required, and adhering to standard specifications as per official guidelines.

faqs.question: Are there alternative submission locations for the application, apart from the Directorate of Fisheries?
faqs.answer: Yes, applicants can submit forms to the official posted at BDO Office/Sub-Offices of the Directorate of Fisheries.

name: Scheme for the Welfare of Schedule Caste Families in Fisheries Sector: Subsidy on Annual Auction of Notified Waters

name: Financial Assistance for Purchase of Barrier Net and its Accessories

Barrier net is a traditional method of catching fish practiced by the fishermen residing near the bank of the river. Under this Scheme financial assistance is provided in the form of a subsidy on the purchase of barrier nets and accessories for the fishermen. The applications are accepted only in offline mode.

name: Financial Assistance for Purchase of Battery Operated Vehicles
description: The scheme “Financial Assistance for Purchase of Battery Operated Vehicles” was launched by the Pondicherry Industrial Promotion Development and Investment Corporation Limited (PIPDIC), Department of Industries & Commerce, Puducherry. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to eligible residents of Puducherry for the purchase of Battery Operated vehicles. The scheme provides financial support, including an investment subsidy of ₹80,000/- provided by the Ministry of New and Renewable Energy, Govt. of India, specifically for Companies or Societies. The applications for this scheme are accepted online through the PIPDIC portal.

If the immovable property used as collateral security is situated outside the Union Territory of Puducherry, its value must be not less than 150% of the loan amount in the case of land with a building, or not less than 200% of the loan amount if the property offered is only land. faqs.question: How do I create an account and begin the registration process on the application portal?
faqs.answer: To create your account, visit the PIPDIC website at https://pipdic.in/, click "Login", and then select the "New customer" link. Enter a unique username, your email address, a secure password, and the Captcha code, then click "Register" to complete the registration process.

faqs.question: What is the purpose of the One-Time Password verification during the login process?
faqs.answer: The OTP is a security measure sent to your registered email address to verify your identity and ensure that only authorized users can access your account. You must enter this OTP and click "Login" to proceed to your customer dashboard.

faqs.question: What information am I required to provide when updating my profile after successful login?
faqs.answer: Upon logging in, you must access the "Edit Profile" option in the top right corner of your dashboard and complete all required profile details as requested by the system. These details are necessary for the loan application processing and verification purposes.

faqs.question: What documents and information should I prepare before starting my loan application?
faqs.answer: Before beginning your loan application, gather all Know Your Customer (KYC) documents and supporting documents as specified in the application checklist. Additionally, prepare detailed biodata information for the Promoter, Partner, or Director, as you will need to upload these documents during the application process.

faqs.question: Where can I access the loan application form once I have completed my profile setup?
faqs.answer: After completing your profile update, navigate to the "Applications" tab on your customer dashboard to access the loan application form section.

faqs.question: What is included in the checklist that appears before I can proceed with the loan application?
faqs.answer: The pop-up checklist displays the General Terms and Conditions, interest rate structure, investigation fees, and collateral security norms applicable to your loan. You must carefully review this information and confirm that you have gathered all necessary documents before proceeding.

faqs.question: What declaration must I read and agree to before submitting my loan application?
faqs.answer: You must read the comprehensive declaration within the application form, which covers confirmation of true and accurate information provided, absence of unauthorized borrowing arrangements, and consent to verification and investigation by PIPDIC officials.

faqs.question: How many steps does the loan application form typically contain, and what should I do if I need to pause my application?
faqs.answer: The loan application is structured as a multi-step form across several stages. While the document does not specify a save-and-resume feature, you should complete all mandatory fields across each required step before proceeding to the next stage.

faqs.question: What is the process for uploading Know Your Customer and supporting documents after submitting my application details?
faqs.answer: After completing the main application form submission, the system will redirect you to enter your Promoter, Partner, or Director biodata information in a multi-step process. For each required document field, click the "Choose File" button, select the appropriate file from your computer in the format specified by the portal, and upload it to the system.

faqs.question: What are the applicable application fees for different loan amounts under this scheme?
faqs.answer: For loan amounts up to ₹25,00,000/-, the application fee is ₹100/-. For loan amounts exceeding ₹25,00,000/-, the application fee is ₹200/-.

faqs.question: How do I make the payment for my application fee, and what happens after successful payment?
faqs.answer: Once your application and biodata submission is complete, proceed to pay the applicable application fee. If you select online payment, the system will automatically redirect you to a payment summary page where you can verify your details and complete the payment transaction.

faqs.question: What should I do with the payment receipt I receive after paying my application fee?
faqs.answer: Upon successful payment, a receipt for your application fee is generated automatically. You can print this receipt or save it to your computer as a PDF for future reference and record-keeping purposes.

faqs.question: How can I track the status of my submitted loan application after submission?
faqs.answer: You can monitor your application status by clicking the "View My Application" link on your customer dashboard and selecting your relevant loan application from the drop-down menu. Your application will initially display a status such as "UNDER REVIEW" as it progresses through processing.

faqs.question: What contact information and support channels are available if I need assistance or wish to file a grievance regarding my application?
faqs.answer: You can contact the Managing Director at the Pondicherry Industrial Promotion Development and Investment Corporation Limited office located at No.60, Romain Rolland Street, Puducherry 605001. The office phone number is 0413-2334361, and you can email your queries to info@pipdic.com. The General Manager (Administration) is also available via mobile contact at 9894653835. You can also submit a grievance form at https://pipdic.in/grievance form.

description: Launched on 15 August 2018, the scheme "₹5 Lakh Insurance Cover for Farmers" is an Insurance Scheme by the Department of Agriculture, Government of Telangana. name: Feed The Seed
description: The "Feed for Seed" program is an initiative launched by the Government of Telangana in India, aimed at promoting agriculture and supporting farmers in the state. The kit also contains instructions on how to grow and harvest the crops, as well as guidelines on seed production and storage. The program is based on the concept of "Seed Village" where farmers can produce high-quality seeds and sell them in the market. The program encourages the use of sustainable agricultural practices such as crop rotation, organic farming, and conservation of traditional crop varieties. The aim of the Feed for Seed program is to increase the availability of high-quality seeds at affordable prices, promote sustainable agriculture practices, and empower farmers to become self-sufficient in seed production. Increased income for farmers: By producing their own seeds, farmers can save money on buying seeds from the market and can also sell their surplus seeds to other farmers, generating additional income. Promotion of sustainable agriculture: The program promotes sustainable agriculture practices such as crop rotation, organic farming, and the conservation of traditional crop varieties, which leads to better soil health, reduced use of chemical inputs, and improved environmental sustainability. name: Fund of Funds for Startups
department: Department For Promotion Of Industry And Internal Trade
description: To meet the funding needs of startups, Government of India has established Fund of Funds for Startup (FFS) under Startup India Programme. Corpus of the FFS is ₹10,000 crore. DPIIT, Government of India is the monitoring agency and SIDBI is the operating agency for FFS. As per the operating guidelines, FFS contributes to the corpus of SEBI registered Alternative Investment Funds (AIFs). These AIFs in turn have to invest at least twice the contribution under FFS, in ‘startups’ as defined by the Government of India gazette notification. The objective of FFS is to provide equity support to startups and encourage innovation and entrepreneurship. It targets DPIIT-recognized startups working in technology, research, and innovation across various sectors. A key feature is the multiplier effect, AIFs must invest at least twice the amount contributed by SIDBI, ensuring more funds flow into the ecosystem. Benefits include access to patient capital, mentorship, and industry networks. The scheme also boosts credibility for startups, making it easier to attract follow-on investments. With an initial corpus of ₹10,000 crore, FFS has supported thousands of startups and promoting innovation. Overall, it plays a vital role in building a strong venture capital market and driving India’s economic growth through entrepreneurship.
benefits: Equity/ equity linked instruments-based funding to startups. Mentorship through experienced AIF managers along with market connects, governance structure. Mobilisation of capital, attracting private investors and mobilising larger capital for startups. Support for innovation-driven enterprises, fostering job creation and economic growth. Strengthens India’s venture capital ecosystem and promotes entrepreneurship. AIFs must invest at least twice SIDBI’s contribution creating a multiplier effect, scheme helped mobilise more than ₹90,000 crore through AIF.
eligibility: Under FFS support is provided to AIFs. Below are the key eligibility criteria for applying for contribution under FFS. • Funds are registered as either Category I or II Alternative Investment Funds (AIF) with Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) or have applied for the same with SEBI.. • Funds with corpus of less than ₹1,000 crores.. • Fund s investment strategy to include investment in startups (Startup as defined as per the Gazette Notification G.S.R.127(E) dt. 19/02/2019 issued by Government of India and as amended from time to time).. • Fund to agree to invest at least twice the amount of contribution sought from FFS into Startups. (For instance, if contribution sought is ₹100 crore under FFS, Fund should invest at least ₹ 200 crore in Startups).. • Fund Manager / team should have prior track record in Fund management or prior investment experience. All the Key members of the Fund should have CIBIL score more than 650 (Key member is defined as Director, Sponsor and Senior Personnel of the Fund).. • All the Key members should be legally eligible to be a Director or in a Managerial position under Indian law (i.e., not barred to be a Director or in a Managerial position under Indian Law).. • Startup should be up to 10 years old from the date of incorporation. • Must be DPIIT-recognized. • Should be working on innovation, development, or improvement of products, processes, or services. • Funding is indirect, through SEBI-registered AIFs supported by SIDBI..
documents: AIF registration certificate 2) IM Agreement 3) Past Track record (If any) 4) PPM (Private Placement Memorandum) 5) AIF and Fund’s Financials 6) Trust Deed 7) Contributors Details 8) Startup Certificate 9) KYC Documents (Aadhar Card, Pan Card (Individual and Company), Financials, CIBIL Score) In case of startups, please visit AIF’s website.
KYC Documents (Aadhar Card, Pan Card (Individual and Company), Financials, CIBIL Score)
In case of startups, please visit AIF’s website.

faqs.question: Does SIDBI charge any processing fee for evaluating proposals under FFS?
faqs.answer: No, SIDBI does not charge any processing fee for evaluating proposals under the FFS programme.

faqs.question: Are category I Funds eligible under FFS?
faqs.answer: Yes, all AIFs registered under SEBI AIF Regulations, 2012 (Category I and II) are eligible.

faqs.question: Is there any corpus limit for AIFs under FFS?
faqs.answer: Yes, AIFs with a corpus of less than ₹1,000 crore are eligible for funding under the FFS scheme. Through modifications under FFS regulations, AIFs with a corpus exceeding ₹1,000 crore can also be supported, subject to the following conditions: • IM must be a domestic entity. • The IM or its key personnel should have previously managed funds to which SIDBI has committed in the past. • SIDBI’s exposure to such funds will be capped at the same level applicable to funds with a corpus of ₹1,000 crore.

faqs.question: Does SIDBI or Government of India have a say in the investment decisions of the AIF?
faqs.answer: No, investment decisions of investing in any startups are taken by the investment committee of respected AIF.

faqs.question: What are the general covenants for AIFs under FFS?
faqs.answer: AIFs must maintain high standards of corporate governance, investor reporting, and comply with SEBI, RBI guidelines.

faqs.question: What is the definition of a Startup under FFS?
faqs.answer: Age: Up to 10 years from incorporation/registration date. Turnover must not have exceeded ₹100 Crore in any financial year since incorporation. It must be incorporated as a Private Limited Company, a Registered Partnership Firm, or a Limited Liability Partnership (LLP) in India. Additionally, it is working towards innovation, development, or improvement of products, processes, or services, with potential for high scalability, employment generation, or wealth creation.

faqs.question: Are AIFs required to be registered with SEBI before approaching SIDBI?
faqs.answer: Yes, SEBI registration is mandatory before applying to SIDBI.

faqs.question: Do startups under FFS need to be registered with the DPIIT?
faqs.answer: Yes, its mandatory.

faqs.question: Is there any sector-specific eligibility for startups under FFS?
faqs.answer: No, FFS is sector-agnostic.

faqs.question: Can AIFs invest in foreign entities under FFS?
faqs.answer: Generally, investments should be in Indian entities. Investments abroad are allowed only as per SEBI/RBI guidelines, but they do not count toward the multiplier condition.

faqs.question: When must AIFs fulfill the condition of investing twice the amount received from FFS?
faqs.answer: This condition must be met by the end of the commitment period of the Fund, with compliance status reported periodically.

faqs.question: What is the term of AIFs under FFS?
faqs.answer: Typically, 8–10 years from Final Closing, not exceeding 12 years.

faqs.question: Can AIFs make warehoused investments before First Closing?
faqs.answer: Yes, they can, and such investments can later be acquired by the Fund at cost without holding charges.

faqs.question: Who decides the investments under AIFs supported by FFS?
faqs.answer: While the VCIC recommends the proposal, final decision of the investment is taken by Executive Committee of SIDBI.

faqs.question: What reporting and compliance requirements apply to AIFs under FFS?
faqs.answer: AIFs must maintain proper records, appoint auditors acceptable to SIDBI, and comply with SEBI, RBI, and KYC norms.
